experiment: empirical time-six hard-partition CVaR density-cap construction
definition: the action is an independent deterministic portfolio in each learned hard state cell; solved cells use their exact conditional minimum-cap martingale LP, strictly separated cells receive zero target mass, and numerically unresolved cells also receive zero mass for the reported constructive upper bound

source_split_unused_for_fitting.weight_definition: exp(log(p/q)); physical estimates are N^-1 sum_r (p/q)_r f_r

portfolio_normalization.definition: calls with K<S are retained; calls with K>=S are replaced at entry by puts through P=C+K-S and dP=dC-dS; spot and option returns are divided by their positive entry prices
portfolio_normalization.cost: coordinatewise proportional cost after entry-value normalization

whitening.definition: xi_t=(x_t-m_t) Q_t Lambda_t^{-1/2}; m_t and covariance are estimated on training paths with physical p/q weights

kernel_basis.definition: physical-weighted MiniBatchKMeans centers in orthogonal t6 state; bandwidth is weighted within-center RMS distance
